reason: Primary purpose is a user-facing game companion layer for DeepSeek Harness that automates Minecraft in-game social behavior (chat, follow, status prompts) and exposes companion-control tools; evidence shows this is centered on companion automation rather than development tooling or data analysis.

summaries.zh: dsh-mc-companion 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Minecraft 插件，为游戏内 AI 伙伴提供自动跟随、聊天回复和短期记忆能力，并通过工具面板便于在会话中查看和控制其状态。
summaries.en: dsh-mc-companion is a DeepSeek Harness Minecraft plugin that provides an in-game AI companion with automated following, chat responses, and short-term memory, plus tool-based controls for status and behavior.

capabilities: In-game social automation via chat responses and proactive companion messages
Player following control including start/stop follow behavior and distance targeting
Companion state, persona, and memory exposure through DSH tool calls (`mc_friend_*`)
Local persistence of conversation facts/memory in `~/.dsh-mc/companion.json`
Event-driven reactions on spawn/player join/death via shared bot hooks

reasons.code: Plugin is documented as a host-only DSH bundle that adds a companion social layer, including chat replies and follow behavior tied to game events.
The plugin depends on and injects the shared `mcBot` service from `dsh-mc-agent`, and uses methods/events such as `chat`, `follow`, `on`, and `setChatResponder` for automated in-game actions.
README states memory is stored locally in `~/.dsh-mc/companion.json` and includes persona/mood/facts/recent messages, indicating local persistence of user interaction data.
Manifest and package metadata mark this as an official DSH bundle plugin (`dsh.bundle.patch`), confirming installation/runtime integration behavior.
